fieldData.titre-h1: Work & Share Nanterre, Delta building
fieldData.accroche: 2 minutes from the RER A, a stone’s throw from La Défense.
fieldData.description-courte: 34 private offices · patio and restaurant
fieldData.l-espace-en-quelques-mots:
Work & Share has moved into Nanterre, at 5 boulevard des Bouvets, in a modern, friendly setting a stone’s throw from La Défense.

Ideally located near the Nanterre courthouse and the Paris La Défense Arena, the space offers a lively, welcoming work environment designed to meet the needs of every business — from small companies to large, growing teams.

With 34 private offices, open-plan spaces and 4 meeting rooms, everything is designed to boost productivity and collaboration. The space also hosts business events for up to 150 attendees: seminars, workshops or conferences.

In the Delta building, enjoy a reception and concierge service, as well as a restaurant and café offering a varied, balanced food selection. Just 2 minutes’ walk from the RER A, Work & Share Nanterre combines accessibility, comfort and conviviality every day.
fieldData.atouts-du-lieu:
• Patio — For a well-deserved break in the fresh air
  • Restaurant and café — Sit-down lunch, alone or with your team
  • Private hire of the space — For events of up to 100 people

fieldData.titre-h1: Work & Share Suresnes, Vita building
fieldData.accroche: A 300 m² rooftop facing Paris and La Défense.
fieldData.description-courte: 300 m² rooftop · 25 private offices
fieldData.l-espace-en-quelques-mots:
Work & Share has moved into Suresnes, in the heart of the Vita building: a modern, inspiring haven of peace just 10 minutes from La Défense.

In a green setting, a stone’s throw from the Seine, the île de Puteaux and the Bois de Boulogne, this space strikes the perfect balance between calm and energy.

Across 1,500 m², enjoy 25 private offices (up to 200 desks), a hot-desking area, around ten meeting rooms, alcoves and phone booths for both focus and collaboration.

The many terraces, patios and the 300 m² rooftop offer stunning views over Paris and La Défense. Certified Osmoz, BREEAM, BiodiverCity and R2S, Vita is a sustainable, comfortable workplace with a strong focus on wellbeing.

Work & Share has moved into Saint-Cloud, in Les Bureaux de la Colline: a bright, warm and friendly 1,200 m² space designed to meet all your business needs.

With 32 private offices and large open-plan areas, the space can host up to 180 residents in a flexible, inspiring work setting. The 5 meeting rooms and the large bistro with a stunning view of the Eiffel Tower are the perfect setting to combine performance and shared moments.

fieldData.titre-h1: Work & Share Levallois-Perret, Carré Vert and Talan
fieldData.accroche: Two managed and private office spaces, a few minutes from metro line 3.
fieldData.description-courte: Managed offices · 2,900 m² across two spaces
fieldData.l-espace-en-quelques-mots:
With nearly 2,900 m² across two spaces, Work & Share Levallois-Perret welcomes teams of 2 to 200 people looking for flexibility and comfort.

At Carré Vert, the 1,670 m² space has 4 managed office floors of 48 to 62 desks. At Talan, the 1,200 m² space offers two floors of 48 and 70 desks, as well as private offices of 2 to 7 desks. Each floor is laid out to suit your needs: open space, closed offices, meeting rooms and phone booths, combining conviviality and privacy.

Residents also enjoy welcoming shared spaces: a tea room, chill-out corner and locker areas at Carré Vert, and a ground-floor garden at Talan.

Both spaces are ideally located in Levallois, a few minutes from metro line 3 – Anatole France, and offer a modern, strategic work setting.

The Work & Share turnkey offer includes all services and a dedicated operations team.
fieldData.atouts-du-lieu:
• Tea room, chill-out corner and lockers — at Carré Vert
  • Ground-floor garden — at Talan
  • Dedicated operations team, turnkey services

fieldData.l-espace-en-quelques-mots:
Work & Share has moved into the heart of La Défense, in the Tour Franklin: a bright, friendly and flexible space.

Spread over two floors, our 3,500 m² welcome every profile: from independent entrepreneurs to large, growing teams. The 6th floor offers flexible offices and inspiring open-plan spaces, while the 7th is dedicated to our managed offices, designed for companies of 20 people or more, combining privacy and turnkey services.

Our private offices are fully equipped and complemented by several meeting rooms, phone booths, lounge areas and a creative room. Residents also enjoy a friendly bistro, a table football room and relaxation areas that encourage people to connect.

A stone’s throw from lines 1, U, L and the RER A, the space is easy to reach from Paris and its suburbs.

fieldData.accroche: Un Business Center 100 % dédié à vos événements, jusqu’à 460 participants.
fieldData.description-courte: Business Center EOS · événements jusqu’à 460 participants
fieldData.l-espace-en-quelques-mots:
Au cœur de l’ensemble de bureaux EOS à Issy-les-Moulineaux, Work & Share ouvre un Business Center de 2 800 m² 100 % dédié aux événements professionnels, jusqu’à 460 participants.

  • 2 auditoriums et 1 amphithéâtre (50 à 230 places)
  • 1 salle immersive et 1 studio virtuel
  • 1 grande salle de réunion équipée
  • Un espace événementiel avec bar pour cocktails et afterworks

Avec une régie technique permanente et 4 Event Managers dédiés, vos conférences, séminaires, lancements de produit ou tournages sont organisés clé en main, de la conception à la réalisation.
fieldData.atouts-du-lieu:
• Deux auditoriums et un amphithéâtre, de 50 à 230 places
  • Une salle immersive et un studio virtuel
  • Un espace cocktail avec bar
  • Une régie technique permanente et 4 Event Managers dédiés
  • Offre traiteur, du petit-déjeuner au cocktail

fieldData.titre-h1: Work & Share Colombes
fieldData.accroche: À la frontière de La Garenne-Colombes, une grande terrasse et une salle de sport.
fieldData.description-courte: 300 postes · terrasse et salle de sport
fieldData.l-espace-en-quelques-mots:
Situé à la frontière de La Garenne-Colombes, dans un quartier vivant et animé, notre espace offre un environnement chaleureux et convivial, idéal pour tous les formats de travail — de l’entrepreneur solo à la grande entreprise.

Avec 300 postes répartis entre bureaux privatifs et open spaces, chacun y trouve la configuration qui lui correspond.

Profitez d’une grande terrasse aménagée pour vos pauses ou vos événements, d’un espace fitness proposant des cours variés, et d’une offre food healthy grâce au restaurant et à la cafétéria sur place.

Pour vos réunions ou séminaires, 6 salles modulables accueillent jusqu’à 120 participants dans un cadre moderne et inspirant. Un lieu où efficacité, détente et convivialité se rencontrent au quotidien.
fieldData.atouts-du-lieu:
• Terrasse — Pour une pause bien méritée, au grand air
  • Parking privatif — Des places réservées à la location pour nos résidents
  • Salle de sport — Pour se maintenir en forme entre deux meetings
  • Privatisation de l’espace — Pour des events jusqu’à 100 personnes
